# solution_complete calibrated from 0.8 to 0.6

Decision by the founder, 23 September 2026, on five measurements across two five-point tickets:

| Ticket | clarified | solution_complete |
|---|---|---|
| SEEN-006 | 0.72, 0.79, then 0.81 once the ticket itself was amended | 0.46, 0.52, then 0.72 after the question was sharpened |
| SEEN-089 | 0.81 first attempt | 0.50, then 0.51 after four real gaps were closed |

Closing four genuine gaps in the SEEN-089 record moved the score by 0.01, which is the signal: the
bar was wrong for this question rather than the records being poor. `clarified` clearing 0.8 twice
shows the same threshold doing useful work on a question that can actually reach it.

This is a threshold changed while a ticket is blocked by it, which is the pattern thresholds.toml
exists to expose, so it is recorded here with the numbers, in the ticket's Outcome, and in a comment
beside the value itself. The alternatives were a human override on every large ticket, which makes
the gate ceremonial, and splitting large tickets to raise their scores, which is ceremony of a
different kind.
